body.x: Jeonju IT&CT Industry Promotion Agency(JICA) participated in the world's largest IT and electronics exhibition CES2020 held in Las Vegas January 7 to 10.

JICA supports local start-up companies andis working on developing advanced information and communication technology(ICT) and contents industry together. Its main project is smart cities. JICA isbuilding a smart city where people can enjoy a convenient and happy life byhaving the citizens take the lead in solving the city problems.
The official said, “We participated in CES2020 to apply advanced technologies to the smart city project in Jeonju city inline with the new industrial movement.”

JICA presented the digital twin-basedspatial information as the outcome of the smart city industry that embodies thereal world together with LX and Hancom group. They built a 4km x 4km pilot digital twin smart city around Jeonju andGochang. They are planning to build the entire Gochang city as a digital spaceby next year.

The official said, “Naver recently decidedto participate in Jeonju smart city project with its business platform. We willmake efforts to create an ecosystem where influential central corporations andlocal industries work together. In CES, we would like to meet partners who cancooperate with us and make performance together.”

The world’s largest IT show CES shows thetrend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted byConsumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS hasreported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major techexhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES thisyear to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstandingKorean companies to the world.
